About Grimdark Builds

Grimdark Builds is an independent, unofficial fan site for Warhammer 40,000 hobby beginners. We write plain-English guides to armies, starter sets, painting and the first steps of the hobby.

The site is run from Denmark by hobbyists, for hobbyists. Some pages contain affiliate links — see our Affiliate Disclosure.

Warhammer 40,000 is a trademark of Games Workshop. Grimdark Builds is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Games Workshop. All product names mentioned remain the property of their respective owners.
